details.Calculates / describes: SENSITIVE DOMAIN — what the tradition computes, never advice about a real relationship. The North-Indian aṣṭakūṭa (36-guṇa: varṇa 1, vaśya 2, tārā 3, yoni 4, graha-maitrī 5, gaṇa 6, bhakūṭa 7, nāḍī 8) and the South-Indian ten porutham (dina, gaṇa, mahendra, strī-dīrgha, yoni, rāśi, rāśyādhipati, vaśya, rajju, vedhā — rajju/vedhā are vetoes) scored between two sidereal Moons. Every rule cited; contested values flagged and never resolved (varṇa air/earth swap; graha-maitrī & gaṇa grids via variantSet; the nāḍī exempt lists; the bhakūṭa points-restoration dispute; the North/South 5-9 contradiction shown both ways). The saravali vaśya table omits Sagittarius — a flagged completion scores it, and the engine throws if that is disabled. Reuses NATURAL_RELATION (BPHS 3.55–57). No demonstrated validity.
details.Local engine inputs: Required: boyMoonSidLon: the groom's sidereal Moon longitude (°); girlMoonSidLon: the bride's sidereal Moon longitude (°)
details.Input boundary: Local engine function arguments are not MCP call arguments. Use the exact schema for each named MCP tool; adapters may recompute charts and provide curated datasets instead of accepting them.
details.Source: saravali.github.io koota pages (verbatim); prokerala/epanchang/astroved porutham pages; B. V. Raman, "Muhurtha"; BPHS 3.55–57 (naisargika friendship). Anchors: Muhūrta Cintāmaṇi (aṣṭakūṭa), the Tamil pañcāṅga / Kālaprakāśikā (porutham, flagged unverified).
details.MCP required inputs: workbench_kuta: groom.dateISO (string), groom.lat (number), groom.lon (number), groom.timeZone (string), bride.dateISO (string), bride.lat (number), bride.lon (number), bride.timeZone (string)
details.MCP scope: Explicit known births, canonical Moons, named table variants; no relationship advice.
details.Availability: Implemented in this repository source; hosted availability requires tools/list after deployment.
